reason: Primary functionality is session-to-outline conversion: the plugin reads the current DSH chat history, extracts usable conclusions/decisions/todos, lets users edit that structure, and exports it as mind-map-like documents in several formats, which is best classified as visualization with supporting utility processing.

summaries.zh: SessionGraph 是一个 DSH Web 插件，可将当前会话整理为可编辑的结构化导图，并导出为 Markdown、Mermaid、PlantUML、XMind 文本或 TODO 清单。
summaries.en: SessionGraph is a DSH web plugin that summarizes a current chat session into an editable structured mind map and exports it as Markdown, Mermaid, PlantUML, XMind text, or a TODO brief.

capabilities: Reads current conversation snapshot from the active DSH web session
Parses and filters message content to extract summary-oriented nodes
Builds an editable mind-map style outline in popup UI
Exports summaries to multiple local text/diagram formats
Provides copy export for structured results

reasons.code: README states the plugin adds a `SessionGraph ▾` button in the conversation input area and presents session summaries as an editable mind map.
README and package metadata describe it as a DSH web plugin with web platform client runtime injection and browser-side entrypoints.

README documents local extractor behavior: reading ConversationSnapshot messages, skipping noise (logs/stack traces/commands), and generating outputs like Markdown, Mermaid, PlantUML, XMind text, and TODO briefs.
